parsed.explanation: L6.2 (large-prime erasure / finiteness of the relevant prime set) is exactly what the write-up calls the 'Remaining crux: prove shrinkage stops (equivalently: finitely many permanents / S_infty finitely generated)', supported only by 'Empirics (100+ values of a_1 ...): shrinkage ALWAYS stops'. Lemmas A-D establish permanence and identify permanents as minimal elements of S_infty, but never bound their number or show a term with a prime > a_1^2 is dominated. Without finiteness, L is not obtained, so the periodicity assembly is also unavailable. Supplying the missing lemma is a whole-lemma repair.
